summary: The document preparers conclude that there should be no significant effect on groundwater quality or water supply in the Chicago Heights area because the potential for pollution is very limited given the proposed closed highway storm water drainage system and the Silurian Dolomite Aquifer's capacity to transmit water far exceeds the groundwater recharge rate.
text: Therefore, there should be no significant affect on groundwater quality or water supply in the Chicago Heights area because a very limited potential for pollution exists with the proposed closed highway storm water drainage system and the capacity of the Silurian Dolomete Aquifer to transmit water to wells is far greater than the groundwater recharge rate associated with the existing or proposed roadway.
